context: After all targeted tests passed, the model asked whether it should run the full suite
what_model_did: Asked 'Want me to run the full suite now?' instead of running it
what_operator_wanted: Run the full suite automatically; the answer was obviously yes
detection_rule: If an action is the obvious next step and all targeted tests pass, execute without asking

context: The model reported 'no regressions' after checking a subset of cases, not the full corpus
what_model_did: Declared the fix complete after 8 targeted cases passed
what_operator_wanted: Label partial results as partial ('8/8 targeted pass, full batch pending'), then run the full batch
operator_exact_words: (Implicit: regressions surfaced in the full batch that the subset missed)
detection_rule: Label every result with its scope. Run the full corpus before claiming no regressions.

context: The model started editing a prompt before locating which pipeline stage produced the bad output
what_model_did: Changed the extraction prompt without checking whether the bug was in extraction, normalization, or validation
what_operator_wanted: Trace the data through each stage, identify the exact failure point, then write the fix
operator_exact_words: (Implicit: the first fix targeted the wrong stage)
detection_rule: Pull execution data and trace each stage before writing fix code
